title: Extracting the index component of a nested pair
statement: For any bit strings $x,U,t,u,j,p$, form the pair whose first component is the encoding of $(x,U)$ and whose second component is the encoding of the pair consisting of $(u,j)$ and $p$. The second component of the decoded pair within that second component is $j$.
